current.text: Porter is projected as Cleveland's backup point guard to start the season. Malik Thomas may also get a look in that role.
Cleveland lost Schroder, Ellis and Strus from the bench, and the second unit has no clear point guard.
This is his fourth NBA season.
This season is now or never for him to win a rotation spot.
Cleveland has the most back-to-backs in the league.
With our March 28 end date, Cleveland plays 4, 3 and then 2 games in the fantasy playoff weeks. The finals week starting March 22 is a two-game week.
He can be a 1.3 steals plus blocks per game player.

durable.text: He is a strong defender and one of the best shot-blocking and steal-getting guards in the NBA. The expert compares him to Derrick White.
He averaged a block per game in 21 minutes over the final six games of last season.
He is a solid rebounder and passer.
He is not a scorer. His shooting and offense are iffy, and he is not a great free throw shooter. About 36% from three is a realistic level for him.
His projected scoring is very low, far below the top 250 pool.

note: At Yahoo rank 300 with a value of 0, Porter is not a draft target in our 144-player auction. His projection is only 3.8 PTS in a small role, but last season he played 17.9 minutes and averaged 0.9 STL and 0.6 BLK with 0.9 TO. That makes him a defensive streamer for builds that do not need points. Early in the season, check whether he beats Malik Thomas for the backup point guard minutes and gets near 20 minutes. If he does, his steals and blocks make him worth a waiver add.
